subject: Repurpose intro session into onsite technical workshop — travel window & logistics
messages:
From: Oliver Grant <oliver@retailx.com>
To: marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 10 May 2027 09:12:00 -0400
Subject: Quick request — change May 24 demo to onsite scoping workshop?

Hi Marissa,

Thanks for scheduling the intro demo for May 24. Our execs did a last-minute calendar shuffle and they’d prefer to turn the session into a half-day onsite technical workshop so we can get the engineering team involved and scope integration work in the same room.

High-level constraints:
- Preferred window: May 21–23 (we can host in our NYC office).
- Must include our infra lead (Priya Singh) and our integrations manager.
- We need an agenda that includes runtime/latency discussion, data flow, and a quick checklist for SSO/KMS access.

Are you able to pivot the May 24 intro into an on-prem/onsite scoping session in that window? If so, we’ll coordinate logistics on our side (visitor badges, conference room).

Oliver
Oliver Grant
VP, Platform Engineering | RetailX
oliver@retailx.com

---
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Oliver Grant <oliver@retailx.com>, Priya Singh <priya.singh@retailx.com>
Cc: dylan_brooks@redwood.com, ava_chen@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 11 May 2027 10:03:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Quick request — change May 24 demo to onsite scoping workshop?

Thanks for the note, Oliver — happy to repurpose.

On converting the intro into a half-day onsite technical workshop: that makes sense given the goal to get engineering alignment and unblock a POC faster. I’ve attached a draft agenda (workshop-agenda-v2.pdf) — high level below:

- 09:00 – 09:15: Introductions & goals (exec + eng alignment)
- 09:15 – 10:15: Architecture & integration patterns (runtime team)
- 10:15 – 10:30: Break
- 10:30 – 11:30: Hands-on: sample integration + data flow (bring sample payloads)
- 11:30 – 12:00: Roadmap, next steps, and POC checklist (security & ops asks)

Logistics/questions for you:
- Can you confirm whether May 21 or May 23 works better? We have limited travel slots but can commit to either date if we lock it this week.
- Can RetailX provide a guest Wi‑Fi SSID and a local contact for visitor badges? If there are any VPN/port restrictions we’ll need to know in advance — Dylan will need early access to a staging endpoint or an API key.
- Please confirm the list of attendees from your side (names + roles).

I’ve looped in Dylan (runtime lead) and Ava (solutions lead) so they can surface required artifacts (staging key, runtime checklist). We’ll update the agenda based on your attendee list.

Attachments: workshop-agenda-v2.pdf, venue-requirements.docx
HubSpot: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/deal/DEAL-4932

If May 23 is available we’ll put travel on our side to match that day — otherwise May 21 is the fallback.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Senior Sales Engineer | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0192

---
From: Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.com>
To: marissa_cole@redwood.com, ava_chen@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 12 May 2027 14:18:00 -0400
Subject: RE: Repurpose intro session into onsite technical workshop — travel window & logistics (internal)

Marissa / Ava — quick internal note on availability and technical asks.

I’m +1 for onsite; helps de-risk integration. A few constraints from my side:
- Travel: I’m out May 24–26 for another customer; can do 21 or 23 (prefer 23 so I’m not cutting it close to the other trip).
- Attendees to bring from our side: me (runtime), Aisha or Markus (inference infra), and one SRE for network checks.
- Must get a staging endpoint and an API key at least 48h before the workshop to validate routing policies and KMS handshake. If RetailX has IP allowlists, we’ll need the office egress IPs (I’ve added that to venue-requirements.docx).

If we confirm May 23, I can block travel and prep a short lab (45 mins) showing KV cache behavior and expected latency under batch. If they insist on May 21, we can still do it but lead time for the lab will be shorter.

Also: recommend we prepare a one-page pre-read for the RetailX infra lead (Priya) that lists required access and a minimal sample payload for the hands-on. I can draft that if you want.

—Dylan
Dylan Brooks
Runtime Lead | Redwood Inference

---
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Oliver Grant <oliver@retailx.com>, Priya Singh <priya.singh@retailx.com>
Cc: dylan_brooks@redwood.com, ava_chen@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 14 May 2027 16:22:00 -0400
Subject: Final: Onsite technical workshop confirmed for May 23 (agenda + invites)

Oliver / Priya — great to sync. Thanks for accommodating the change.

We’ll plan for Tuesday, May 23, onsite at your NYC office. Calendar invite has been sent (link below) and I attached the updated agenda + venue checklist. Quick confirmations we still need from you:
- Final attendee list (names + emails, please include any contractor badges needed)
- Visitor badge contact & parking instructions
- Guest Wi‑Fi SSID and any firewall/IP allowlist details for our staging IPs
- Will you provide a projector/HDMI + whiteboard? If not we’ll bring a travel projector.
- Catering preference (we can coordinate continental breakfast + lunch if you’d like us to arrange).

We’ll arrive the evening before if helpful — Dylan prefers to have the staging key and a test payload by EOD Friday (May 21) so he can validate connectivity. I’ve included a one-page pre-read for Priya in the attachment (prep-checklist).

HubSpot deal: DEAL-4932 — I updated the record with the new workshop plan and travel request.
Calendar invite: https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=abc123
Attachments: workshop-agenda-v2.pdf, venue-requirements.docx

If anything changes on your side, ping me and we’ll re-evaluate. Looking forward to the deep dive — should help accelerate a scoped POC quickly.

Best regards,
